name: fbi-steve-jobs.pdf
description: The FBI's 1991 background check on Steve Jobs, run when he was considered for the President's Export Council, plus a 1985 bomb threat case against Apple. Interviewees praised his drive, while some said he would 'twist the truth and distort reality' to reach his goals.
